About KISFIT Bio Labs

KISFIT Bio Labs (kisfitglobal.com) is a specialized pediatric growth trajectory and neurocognitive development studio engineered for parents seeking hospital-grade, evidence-based clarity on their child's physical stature and executive brain development.

Rather than relying on generic height charts or unverified supplement marketing, our calculation engine cross-analyzes day-exact chronological age, biological sex, multi-ethnic calibration, mid-parental target height (MPH), sleep architecture, nutritional bioavailability, and prefrontal study habits against 3,722 peer-reviewed clinical publications.

US CDC 2000 & WHO MGRS Continuous Box-Cox LMS (Lambda-Mu-Sigma) z-score interpolation for exact height, weight, and BMI-for-age percentiles from infancy through age 20.
3-Tier Adult Height Simulation Combines Tanner Mid-Parental Target Height (MPH) and Khamis-Roche non-invasive bone-age modeling to project Unmanaged, Genetic Baseline, and Optimized Catch-Up trajectories.

1. Pediatric Auxology & Endocrine Evidence Base (1,576+ Studies)

Approximately 65% to 75% of pulsatile human growth hormone (HGH) is secreted during nocturnal Slow-Wave Sleep (Stage N3), which is highly sensitive to pre-bedtime insulin elevation and circadian melatonin onset. Simultaneously, epiphyseal chondrocyte proliferation and osteoblast mineralization depend on weight-adjusted bioavailable micronutrients—specifically elemental Calcium Citrate, Vitamin D3 (Cholecalciferol), Vitamin K2 (MK-7) for osteocalcin carboxylation, and Chelated Zinc for hepatic IGF-1 synthesis.

2. Neurocognitive & Executive Function Evidence Base (2,138+ Studies)

Our Brain Learning Quotient (LQ) assessment diagnoses the exact cognitive bottleneck holding back a child's academic efficiency—whether passive reading illusions, working-memory overload on multi-step problems, or smartphone-induced prefrontal dopamine fatigue—and prescribes age-calibrated Feynman Blank-Page Active Recall, Cornell 3-Color Error Tagging, and Singapore Bar-Modeling protocols.

3. Medical & Educational Disclaimer

KISFIT Bio Labs provides a clinical wellness and educational guidebook synthesized from public pediatric auxology standards (US CDC, WHO, AAP, PES) and peer-reviewed literature. Our reports and calculators are designed for informational and home-optimization purposes only and do not constitute formal medical diagnosis, endocrine prescription, or treatment. Always consult a board-certified pediatrician or pediatric endocrinologist for medical concerns.
